name: Youth Services
what_you_do: Get help finding a job and planning your next steps. If you are still in high school, you may qualify for a work experience placement with an employer partner.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 14 to 24. The board's youth site names Arcadia, Duarte, Sierra Madre, South Pasadena and Pasadena as its service area.
pay_detail: The page does not say if work experience is paid.
deadline_text: No dates are listed as of Nov 3, 2026. Orientation dates are on the board's website calendar.
how_to_apply: Call the office at (626) 304-8905, or go to the next orientation. Main office: (626) 796-5627.
notes: Ask if the work placement is paid. If it is, you need a work permit while under 18. The office is at 1207 E. Green Street, Pasadena.
